name: BanTheFake: check images
description: Right-click an image to check it with your BanTheFake server. Sends images only to the server you configure, only when you click.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; connect-src https: http://localhost:* http://127.0.0.1:* data:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
